description: This Java source file defines the class AcknowledgementForwarderActorStarter, which manages the starting and handling of acknowledgement forwarder actors within an Akka actor system, including logic for correlation IDs, acknowledgment requests filtering, and actor creation.

classes.name: AcknowledgementForwarderActorStarter
classes.description: Manages the starting and coordination of acknowledgement forwarder actors, including handling correlation IDs, acknowledgment requests filtering, and actor creation within an Akka actor system.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of AcknowledgementForwarderActorStarter with specified context, entity ID, signal, acknowledgement configuration, and acknowledgment label predicate.

methods.name: getAllowedAckRequests
methods.description: Returns the set of acknowledgment requests that are permitted for this actor starter, filtered based on the signal and predicate.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Attempts to start an acknowledgement forwarder actor if effective acknowledgment requests exist; returns an Optional containing the ActorRef if successful.

methods.name: getConflictFree
methods.description: Starts an acknowledgement forwarder with a conflict-free correlation ID, generating new IDs if necessary to avoid conflicts.

methods.name: joinPrefixAndCounter
methods.description: Concatenates a prefix and counter to form a correlation ID string.

methods.name: parseCorrelationId
methods.description: Parses the correlation ID from headers, extracting prefix and numeric suffix if present.

methods.name: startAckForwarderActor
methods.description: Creates and starts an acknowledgement forwarder actor with specified headers.

methods.name: getDuplicateCorrelationIdException
methods.description: Builds an exception indicating duplicate correlation ID issues.

methods.name: declineAllNonDittoAckRequests
methods.description: Sends NACK responses for acknowledgment requests with labels not defined by Ditto.

methods.name: getNack
methods.description: Constructs a NACK acknowledgement message for a given label and exception.

methods.name: isNotBuiltIn
methods.description: Checks if an acknowledgment request is not a built-in type (live response or twin persisted).

methods.name: isNotTwinPersisted
methods.description: Checks if an acknowledgment request is not labeled as TWIN_PERSISTED.

methods.name: isNotLiveResponse
methods.description: Checks if an acknowledgment request is not labeled as LIVE_RESPONSE.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Determines if a signal is a live signal based on its headers.

methods.name: hasEffectiveAckRequests
methods.description: Determines if the signal has acknowledgment requests that are effective based on signal type and acknowledgment labels.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a substring of a string starting at a given index is a valid number.
